messages.subject: Project Harbor - completion arrangements
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Completion checklist attached. We propose a virtual completion on 4 December: documents to be held to order, signatories pre-positioned, funds to flow on confirmation. Castle & Vane to bring down the disclosure and deliver the transfers, certificates, statutory books and resignations; we deliver the Bidco board minutes and arrange the payments. Please review the checklist and let us know of any gaps.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
